uiFrames.html:
<form>
  <fieldset><legend>Which colour should the logo be?</legend>
    <label><input type="radio" name="colour" value="red"> Red</label>
    <label><input type="radio" name="colour" value="green" checked> Green</label>
    <label><input type="radio" name="colour" value="blue"> Blue</label>
  </fieldset>
  <fieldset><legend>Which toppings?</legend>
    <label><input type="checkbox" name="toppings" value="cheese"> Cheese</label>
    <label><input type="checkbox" name="toppings" value="olives"> Olives</label>
    <label><input type="checkbox" name="toppings" value="mushrooms"> Mushrooms</label>
  </fieldset>
  <label>Anything else? <textarea name="notes"></textarea></label>
</form>
